<?php
class CaptureA57 { public function __destruct() { echo 'A|'; } }
class CaptureB57 { public function __destruct() { echo 'B|'; } }
function Run57() {
    global $g;
    echo 'CALL|';
    $value = $g->current();
    echo 'VALUE|', (int) ($value === 'value57');
    return 'fiber57';
}
$token = new CaptureA57();
$weakA = WeakReference::create($token);
$factory = function () use ($token) {
    echo 'GEN|';
    $reply = Fiber::suspend('pause57');
    echo 'CAPTURE|', (int) ($token instanceof CaptureA57), (int) ($reply === 'resume57');
    unset($token);
    yield 'value57';
    echo 'GEN-END|';
    return 57;
};
$weakClosure = WeakReference::create($factory);
$g = $factory();
unset($factory);
$f = new Fiber('Run57');
echo 'START|';
$pause = $f->start();
echo 'PARK|', (int) ($pause === 'pause57'), (int) ($weakA->get() !== null), (int) ($weakClosure->get() !== null);
echo 'RETARGET|';
$token = new CaptureB57();
$weakB = WeakReference::create($token);
echo 'OLD|', (int) ($weakA->get() !== null);
echo 'RESUME|';
$reply = $f->resume('resume57');
echo 'FIBER|', (int) ($reply === null), (int) ($f->getReturn() === 'fiber57');
unset($token);
$g->next();
echo 'CLOSED|', (int) ($g->getReturn() === 57), (int) ($weakClosure->get() !== null), (int) ($weakA->get() !== null), (int) ($weakB->get() !== null);
unset($g, $f);
echo 'DROP|', (int) ($weakClosure->get() === null), (int) ($weakA->get() === null), (int) ($weakB->get() === null);
unset($weakClosure, $weakA, $weakB, $pause, $reply);
echo 'E';

<?php
$capture = 'cap57';
$factory = function () use ($capture) {
    echo 'GEN|', (int) ($capture === 'cap57');
    Fiber::suspend('pause57');
    yield 'after57';
    return 57;
};
$g = $factory();
unset($factory, $capture);
$f = new Fiber(function () {
    global $g;
    return $g->current();
});
echo 'START|';
$pause = $f->start();
echo 'PARK|', (int) ($pause === 'pause57'), (int) $f->isSuspended();
try {
    $g->next();
    echo 'NO-ERROR|';
} catch (Error $error) {
    echo 'ERROR|', (int) ($error->getMessage() === 'Cannot resume an already running generator'),
         (int) ($error->getPrevious() instanceof Error);
}
echo 'RESUME|', (int) ($f->resume() === null);
echo 'VALUE|', (int) ($f->getReturn() === 'after57');
$g->next();
echo 'RETURN|', (int) ($g->getReturn() === 57);
unset($error, $g, $f, $pause);
echo 'E';
